verdict.rationale: Spending caps are a fair question for a serverless cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents hard spending limits or budget caps for Workers. The nearest items are adjacent: AI Gateway rate limiting, AI Gateway cost metrics, and compute-only billing. None of these is a spending cap, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
